## Summary

The root cause of the issue was a **corrupted `termios.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so` file** in the conda environment. The file was significantly smaller than expected (22120 bytes vs 31296 bytes), which caused the `termios` module to fail to load its constants like `TCSAFLUSH`. This cascaded to break the `tty` and `pty` modules that depend on `termios`.

**Fix applied:** Replaced the corrupted termios shared object file with the working version from the system Python installation:
```
cp /usr/lib/python3.10/lib-dynload/termios.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/lib-dynload/termios.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so
```

The test `tests/test_echo.py::PtyEchoTestCase::test_waitnoecho_timeout` now passes successfully.
